show.description: When Ruhaan Kapoor loses his company, parents, and marriage, he believes his wife Ishani betrayed him for money. What he never knows is that Ishani secretly divorced him to donate her heart to billionaire Prithviraj Bhalla in exchange for saving Ruhaan’s collapsing empire. Living on an artificial heart while raising their daughter Mishti, she lets Ruhaan hate her so he can rebuild. Five years later, Ruhaan learns the truth—but by then, Ishani is dying.
